paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者回忆一次普通阅读被身体相关想法打断，却不愿描述外表，也不确定那次是否涉及用外表评价价值。他可以把“被打断”与“另一句无法判断”分别保留，不需要得出对整个身体的结论。指南没有看见他的身体，不评想法是否准确，也不要求找镜子、照片或比较对象来核对。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls body-related thoughts interrupting ordinary reading, without wanting to describe appearance or knowing whether that moment involved judging worth. An interruption and uncertainty about another statement can remain separate without a whole-body verdict. The guide has seen no body, assesses no accuracy of the thought and requests no mirror, photograph or comparison as verification.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“相关想法让我难以继续一件日常事；具体外表我暂时不想谈；我还不知道原因。”也可以只读这张虚构卡，不写个人经历。听者不必评价身体、提供外表保证或要求积极评价；实际顾虑可以被听见，不需要身体证据或类别计数。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can name thoughts making an ordinary task difficult, keep appearance private and leave the cause unknown. Read the fictional card without writing a personal account. A listener need not judge a body, reassure about appearance or require a positive body opinion. An actual concern can be heard without physical evidence or category counts.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者读到本主题时，不确定自己记得的某个安排是否符合句中所说的原因。他可以选无法判断，而不是把所有与食物有关的安排都归入一种规则。另一个人选择相同类别，也可能有完全不同的背景。指南没有足够信息区分实际需要与担忧，不评价已有照护，也不安排一餐或一次改变来证明答案。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader is unsure whether a recalled arrangement fits the reason stated in a prompt. Cannot judge can remain instead of grouping every food-related arrangement under one rule. Another person choosing the same category may have a different context. The guide lacks information to distinguish actual needs from worry, evaluates no existing care and assigns no meal or change as proof of an answer.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡可以只说：“这句的原因部分我不确定；我不想用网页给饮食安排下结论；实际顾虑可以另谈。”可以只讨论虚构例子，不交代食物、数量或具体规则。听者无需要求证明灵活，也不把计数当作改变进食的依据；需要支持时不必先全部符合。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can keep the reason in a statement uncertain, leave dietary arrangements unjudged by a webpage and allow an actual concern to be discussed separately. Discuss the fictional example without foods, amounts or specific rules. A listener need not require proof of flexibility or use counts to justify changing eating. Support requires no complete endorsement.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader wants to tell a professional about remembered difficulty choosing and later distress, without foods, amounts, timing or a detailed account. That broad description requires no proof of a clinical event. Distress and keeping details private establish no character judgment. The guide classifies no meal as normal or abnormal and requests no reenactment, stopping test or missing private details.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡把“记得的选择感”“目前的困扰”“暂不展开的内容”分开。可以只读虚构卡，不填写记录或向朋友证明坦诚；听者可以了解顾虑，不评价自律，也不要求达到某个量或定义。是否继续谈以及谈多少，均不由本页计数决定。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates remembered choice, current distress and details kept private. Read the fictional card without logging an event or proving openness to friends. A listener can hear the concern without grading discipline or requiring an amount or definition. Counts decide neither whether nor how much to discuss.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader wants to express concern about feeling obliged to make up for eating, without saying whether, how or how often anything happened. Details can stay unknown; withholding proves no hidden action and few fitting statements give no all-clear verdict. This example supplies no method, comparison or substitute action. Support for a real concern needs no additional evidence first.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想讨论这种担忧；具体经历暂时不展开；我不想用类别多少判断身体后果。”可以只读虚构卡，不查行为细节、不重做，也不请听者比较方法。公开指南不把进食视为需要挣得或抵消；实际身体顾虑应在适当的个别医疗场合讨论，页面不能判断紧急程度。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can name the concern, keep events private and leave physical consequences unjudged by counts. Read the fictional card without researching details, repeating actions or asking a listener to compare methods. The public guide treats no eating as something to earn or undo. Actual physical concerns belong in an appropriate individual medical setting; the page cannot assess urgency.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls wanting to continue an ordinary article while thoughts returned to an eating occasion. The cause remains unknown and every thought need not be reconstructed. Occupied attention can be described without calculating duration, predicting future eating or explaining physical needs. The guide labels no practical meal planning as distress by default and assigns no monitoring, food diary or more frequent retaking.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡可以从“这件日常活动受到了影响”“原因仍不清楚”“我想保留哪些细节”开始。也可以只读，不作谈话或改变。听者无需数想法、评价进食或找出某种固定模式；希望获得支持时，可以从当前顾虑出发，不必满足其他四个主题的组合。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can start with an affected daily activity, an unknown cause and details to keep private. Reading requires no conversation or change. A listener need not count thoughts, evaluate eating or find a fixed pattern. Support can begin with the current concern without a combination across the other four topics.
